Indian Navy launches final indigenous Diving Support Craft DSC A24

The Indian Navy has launched the final indigenous Diving Support Craft (DSC) A24 in Kolkata. This vessel is designed to strengthen the navy's underwater inspection and salvage capabilities. The DSC A24 is part of a series of indigenous vessels aimed at enhancing the navy's self-reliance in defense manufacturing. Its induction is expected to bolster the navy's operational readiness for underwater tasks.
